# Pulse task #2871: Clear retained clip-resize preview paint after focus cancellation

Operation: 36c8cbbd57c9627a5fcb5d2afd659539
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

Discovered while qualifying Pulse2860/PR462 track-border styling; separate inherited lifecycle defect reproduced on original production tracks.rs5b007628, not caused by the nine-line lane-styling removal. Source/diagnostics: Pulse2860 note29551, unqualified checkpoint717e2829c9b47bd8aa7eda86dd791f48dc2e4210, evidence14f27991c613d352f3696d585ffac7624666b6b7 archive132691B SHA2274fc7d18a6ba39130c280ee0b9ba0cfc74970c153821459cdbb363b1115430. Preserve original immutable evidence; never build evidence refs.

Actual GPUI reproduction: capture a MIDI clip resize, focus mounted browser search, release. Logical trim owner/pending and GPUI active drag clear; canonical Project unchanged and no command queued. Yet actual completed scene retains preview bounds x604.5 y278 w273 h44, opaque black border and filled background. Original baseline-cancel diagnostic0PASS1FAIL8.57s; narrowed actual scene probe0PASS1FAIL0.88s with drag=false. This is completed paint, not merely debug_bounds metadata. No native physical observation or notification/cache cause established. Existing Done2797/PR403 and2846/PR450/history stay intact; this is a focused new follow-up. Duplicate searches preview focus/cancel preview/ghost found no matching focused issue.

Trace actual capture cancellation, GPUI drag preview owner, render invalidation and completed-frame ordering on current canonical source. First preserve/reproduce actual baseline RED with real Service/GPUI pointer and focus delivery, logical owner+pending+canonical/noqueue assertions AND completed scene border/fill. Explain exact cause before minimal repair. Do not force refresh/fake Event, debounce, suppress preview, weaken cancellation, change model/worker/Engine/API or vendor broadly. Return a precise proposal to Root before crossing shared render/capture ownership or public contracts; no new worker.

Acceptance: following actual focus-cancel terminal, preview paint and active drag are absent in the next normal completed frame, canonical project/history unchanged/no queued edit; actual successful resize retains preview through canonical worker ACK and exact accepted extent/one UndoRedo. Cover audio/MIDI and ordinary/Shift/enabledWarp where supported, Escape/stale generation/mode/source replacement/worker refusal controls, no stale scene/duplicate ghost. Preserve accepted463 root pointer delivery and469 captured outside-track release: outside-track MouseUp commits valid captured source; genuine focus loss still cancels. No forced acceptance or blanket hide-on-release. Source-bound affected strict checks and actual cancellation/commit/release controls, then merger exact current full CI/review/merge. Native optimized physical input/render acceptance remains separate.

Keep PR462 focused on lane border: its inherited diagnostic remains preserved in evidence and belongs here; no lifecycle production changes inside462. Existing general worker continues serially after coherent462 handoff; prioritize this focused regression within resize work before broad UI features.
